title: Four-Tokenization Proof Day: Seed Reconstruct, Two Dual-Rail Digest Ceremonies, and a UI-Initiated Hash-Only Bind on Bitcoin and XRP Mainnets, with a Trustless Browser Verification Portal (Session Record, 2026-10-18)
description:
Session record for 2026-10-18: four artifacts tokenized in one day, without tokens, across two mainnets, every step receipted. "The hash is the artifact": only 32-byte SHA-256 fingerprints touch a chain; the assets never move; the proofs do. This software is a prototype and is provided for educational and research purposes only. It is not intended for production use, commercial deployment, or safety-critical environments. All payloads are the owner's own artifacts (POL-DISC-001); no customer-identifiable data appears in this record.

The four ceremonies, all live on mainnet: (1) patent genesis seed 81d4a5cb...c456c dropped on Bitcoin tx 97d8cd38 (block 972023) and reconstructed byte-identically by a keyless reader (DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23455768); (2) DGPNM v1.1 digest 66dc843a...ee9de2b anchored on Bitcoin block 972047 and round-tripped through three XRP mainnet custody hops (ledgers 107746115-107746135) with the memo bytes exactly equal to the document hash; (3) the Governed Cognitive Training draft kept private and published hash-only - digest 7fe02586...e5b2c8b on Bitcoin block 972053 plus XRP ledgers 107746772/107746777 (DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23460521); (4) "How to Patent in 2026" digest 74084eff...af35a92 bound on Bitcoin block 972072 via the first UI-initiated hash-only bind through the Bridge intake queue.

Public verification portal (in-browser, keyless, no Python): https://deterministic-code-dsos.base44.app/genesis-viewer - real-world end-user test passed on block 972053 with a byte-exact match banner. Hardening receipts 0209 (full 64-char XRPL hash restoration, defect disclosed) and 0210 (explorer hostname correction) are included verbatim, append-only doctrine intact. Provenance: append-only public ledger, github.com/LLong2026/four-horsemen (entries 0205-0210 included in this bundle). Communities: DCAI (zenodo.org/communities/dcai) and SQUIRL OS.
